items.say: Boo the ghost found something in the attic. It was made of metal, and it was much too big to wear on a finger. When he shook it, it rang so loudly that the bats flew away. What did Boo find?
Somebody took the pie from the kitchen window. There were feathers on the floor. The thief had flown away over the wall without a sound, long after dark. Who took the pie?

Sir Clank the knight stood in front of a locked gate. He pushed it, and he kicked it, but it would not open. Then a friend dropped something small and metal into his hand. He turned it in the lock, and the gate swung open. What did the friend bring?

Dash the fox walked into a cave. It was so dark that she could not see her own paws. Then a friend handed her a stick with a flame on top, and at last she could see the way. What did the friend give Dash?
The snowman in the castle yard had melted. The grass around it was burned black. Up on the roof, someone with wide wings was trying hard not to sneeze again. Who melted the snowman?

Puff the dragon was lost in the hills. Every path looked the same. Then he remembered the folded paper in his bag. He opened it up, found the river and the bridge drawn on it, and knew which way to go. What did Puff look at?

The band was ready to march, but something was missing. Nobody was keeping the beat. Then Pounce the cat picked up two sticks and went boom, boom, boom. Now everyone could march in step. What was Pounce playing?
The cookie jar was empty, but the kitchen door was still locked from the inside. Nobody had opened the window. The only one who can float straight through a wall was smiling. Who took the cookies?

It rained all night, and the path was full of puddles. Zip the robot did not want rusty feet. So he pulled something tall and rubbery onto each foot and splashed all the way to school. What did Zip put on?

Snowballs were flying across the castle yard. Sir Clank the knight did not want a cold, wet face. He picked up something big, flat and strong, and held it in front of him. Every snowball went splat against it. What was Sir Clank holding?

Somebody tidied the whole workshop while everyone slept. There were drops of oil on the floor. A low beeping sound came from the corner, where someone was plugged into the wall to charge. Who tidied the workshop?
The old king was sad, because nobody at the market knew who he was. So he went home and came back with something golden and shiny on his head. Now everybody bowed. What did the king put on?

Zip the robot wanted to visit the moon. Walking was no good, and even his friends with wings could not fly that high. So Zip built something tall with fire coming out of the bottom, climbed inside, and counted down from ten. What did Zip build?
The milk jug was empty. There were small, muddy paw prints across the kitchen table. Under a chair, someone was licking her whiskers and purring. Who drank the milk?

Hoot the owl sat on her nest all week to keep something warm. It was smooth and round, and she had to be very gentle with it. On Sunday it cracked open, and a tiny beak poked out. What was Hoot sitting on?

Zazz the wizard was so small that he could not reach his own door handle. So he mixed something fizzy in a bottle and drank it all in one gulp. In a blink, he was as tall as a tree. What did Zazz drink?
The hens were upset. Someone with a bushy tail and pointed ears had sneaked through a hole in the fence and run off into the woods. She did not purr, and she did not fly. Who scared the hens?

Pounce the cat could not sleep. So a friend sat beside her, opened something with lots of pages, and read out loud about a brave little mouse. Before the end, Pounce was snoring. What did the friend open?
